NewsArticle.Title: Religious Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content: All worshippers of a religion may worship at an allied deity's Mass. For example, a Luathas worshipper may benefit from a Luathas, Cail, and a Gramail Mass. As before, Mass Worship is available once per real-life week, greatly increases all the participants' faith, and gives between 5000 and 50,000 experience, depending on the faith of the priest holding the Mass Worship. As before, religious faith is used to invoke one of the 200+ unique miracles. Each diety's miracles are unique. Learn more about the Gods of Temuair [here,](http://www.darkages.com/atavism/phi/Chloe_Theology.html) or by studying 'Gods Lore' from a priest or from a mundane in Temuair. The mundane temple attendants now offer Gods Lore. Like other lore, Gods Lore gives experience points the first time you study it. A new, Greater religious Geas (also known as quest) offers 100,000 experience and increased faith for completion. As it has been, only one geas is available once per real-life week. To participate, join one of the [eight religions](http://www.darkages.com/atavism/phi/Chloe_Theology.html) of Temuair and perform the Geas for your priest. The mundane attendants urge Aisling priests to set an appropriately difficult Geas on their worshipper. The Greater Geas greatly decreases the priest's faith, so the Geas should be made useful to the fellowship. The Lesser Geas offers 10,000 experience and slightly increased faith. Only one may be done per real-life week, but does not decrease the priest's faith. A Probate may not complete a geas. A worshipper of an allied diety may complete a religious geas. To become a worshipper, speak with a priest of your chosen religion. A shrine to one of the eight gods lies at the outskirts of each of the seven villages. The shrine to Sgrios, God of Decay, is hidden. See [religious](http://www.darkages.com/play/s_religion.html) and [all](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html) features screenshots.
